title: Can I BEAT Duck Chess?
summary: Duck Chess: after every move the mover must place the duck on any empty square other than where it stands; nothing can move through or onto it and it can't be captured. No checkmate - you win by capturing the king. He parks the duck on e2/d2 to block development and wins all three 5+4 games.
rules: Each turn = one normal chess move, then the SAME player moves the duck to a different empty square (mandatory).
The duck blocks movement: no piece may land on or pass through it; it cannot be captured.
There is no check/checkmate: kings may be left in check and the game is won by capturing the king.
A player may use the duck to block a check against their own king; the opponent cannot then remove the duck before moving.
Duck starts off-board; first placement after White's first move (inferred).
